#!/usr/bin/env python3
import socket, sys, time, select, os, codecs
SOCK='/tmp/alpine-serial.sock'
def read_avail(s, timeout=0.5, maxread=65536):
    out=b''
    end=time.time()+timeout
    while time.time()<end:
        r,_,_=select.select([s],[],[],min(0.1,max(0,end-time.time())))
        if r:
            try: d=s.recv(maxread)
            except Exception: break
            if not d: break
            out+=d
            end=time.time()+0.1
    return out
def main():
    mode=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'shell'
    s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.connect(SOCK)
    s.setblocking(False)
    if mode=='boot':
        data=read_avail(s,1)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(data); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        s.sendall(b'\r')
        end=time.time()+60
        buf=b''
        while time.time()<end:
            d=read_avail(s,1)
            if d:
                buf+=d; sys.stdout.buffer.write(d); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
                if b'login:' in buf[-5000:]:
                    s.sendall(b'root\r')
                    buf=b''
                    # wait for shell prompt
                    end=time.time()+20
                if b'localhost:~#' in buf[-5000:]:
                    s.sendall(b'echo READY_MARKER\r')
                    end=time.time()+3
                if b'READY_MARKER' in buf[-5000:]:
                    print('\n[READY]')
                    break
        s.close()
    elif mode=='cmd':
        # send each arg after initial sync; print output
        read_avail(s,0.5)
        s.sendall(b'\r')
        for cmd in sys.argv[2:]:
            s.sendall(cmd.encode()+b'\r')
            time.sleep(1)
            d=read_avail(s,2)
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(d); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        s.close()
    elif mode=='send':
        # send raw argument, wait given seconds
        s.sendall(sys.argv[2].encode().decode('unicode_escape').encode())
        time.sleep(float(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 1)
        d=read_avail(s,2)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(d); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        s.close()
    elif mode=='read':
        d=read_avail(s,float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 2)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(d); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        s.close()
if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
PY
